entries: Translated Parkes/European binary models compared with native tempo2

Owner instruction 'Yes, compare first'. 19 of 20 agree within 0.1 TOA sigma after the search projection (largest 0.061). Parkes J1603-7202 differs (0.44): a GAUS chromatic event the timing library drops. New guard holds targets with unimplemented terms (also Parkes J1909-3744, TNGROUPNOISE). September isolated searches of these releases contain no such term.
No periodogram; nothing calibrated, frozen or searched. Ready to propose: 12 Parkes, 6 European binaries.
